sound_intent.drums: Crisp, minimal chopped drum samples to create laid-back trip hop groove with cinematic reverbs.
sound_intent.bass: Subtle chopped bass samples with warm saturation to underpin slow build energy.
sound_intent.chords: Sparse, atmospheric chord chops with delay creating cinematic tension.
sound_intent.melody: Filtered reversed chopped samples providing subtle melodic textures.
sound_intent.vocal: Minimal chopped vocal fragments with delay and pitch shift to enhance mood.
sound_intent.fx: Time stretched chopped FX samples for atmospheric transitions and build ups.

routing_intent.drums: Separate channels for slice, roll, and hit samples for individual processing.
routing_intent.bass: Cut and loop channels routed to saturation bus for warm tone.
routing_intent.chords: Stab and pad channels routed via delay sends.
routing_intent.melody: Reverse and glitch channels routed through phaser and reverb inserts.
routing_intent.vocal: Chop and pitch shift channels routed to filter and delay buses.
routing_intent.fx: Time stretch and riser channels automated with reverb and volume envelopes.

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation through minimal sliced samples
track_roles.bass: Sub-bass support and groove with chopped loops
track_roles.chords: Harmonic texture via cinematic stabs and pads
track_roles.melody: Textural melodic elements using reversed chops
track_roles.vocal: Atmospheric vocal chops for emotional color
track_roles.fx: Transitional and atmospheric effects from sample chops

presetor_intent.mix: Maintain clarity and space with minimal layering and slow builds.
